# dsh-n8n-plugin

n8n workflow operations, built into DeepSeek Harness.
Register each n8n instance once — then drive i
t from the Settings page or straight from the agent.
English · 中文
## ✨ Why dsh-n8n-plugin
Most n8n integrations have you paste a base URL and an API key into every conversation. This plugin
makes n8n a **first-class citizen of DeepSeek Harness**: one settings page, one instance registry, a
nd 21 agent tools that share it.

### One alias away from any environment

## ⚙️ How it works
A standard double-sided DSH package: a host half (`lib/`) and a browser half (`client/index.js`, no
ouble-sided DSH package: a host half (`lib/`) and a browser half (`client/index.js`, no build step).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Host half** — `lib/index.js` registers routes, the 21 tools and the optional prompt section from
one `apply()`; `lib/store.js` owns the registry (atomic writes, `0600`, corrupt-file quarantine); `
lib/n8n.js` is the API v1 client (30 s timeout, merged abort signals, `accept-encoding: identity`) p
lus a direct webhook caller and an execution wait poller; `lib/http.js` enforces the loopback fence;

`lib/mount-once.js` guarantees one mount per package and profile.
- **Browser half** — `client/inde

x.js` renders the Settings section and talks to the same routes, so GUI and agent always agree.
- **
Prompt guidance** — `lib/guidance.js` emits the system-prompt section; it renders only when n8n_* to
ols are visible in the session.
## 🛡️ Security model
- `/api/dsh-n8n-plugin/*` accepts loopback requests only, validating the socket address, `Host`, `Or
igin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`; any request carrying `X-Forwarded-For` / `CF-Connecting-IP` is refused.

Never expose this page through a reverse proxy.
- Request bodies are capped at 256 KiB, and response

s are sent `no-store`.
- API keys support three registration modes with priority **environment-varia
ble reference (`apiKeyEnv`) > key-file reference (`apiKeyFile`) > inline (`apiKey`)**; a configured
reference that cannot be resolved fails the call outright instead of silently falling back. Inline k
eys are plaintext in a `0600` user-owned file — the same trust model as `~/.n8n` or a `n8n-api.sh` e

nvironment file. Responses only carry the last four characters.
- Agents can read the instance list

but cannot create or edit an instance: an API key must not be dictated through a conversation.
- Eac
h instance can be switched to **read-only (`readOnly`)**: every state-changing tool call (create/upd
ate/delete/publish/clone/tag writes/execution cancel/webhook call/non-GET `n8n_api`) is then refused

with a hint on where to turn the flag off.
- Every guarded write — including attempts refused by re
ad-only mode — is appended to the audit log `~/.dsh/dsh-n8n-plugin.audit.log` (one JSON object per l
ine: time, agent/web source, tool, instance, target, outcome, duration; no secrets and no response p
ayloads; rotated past 1 MB keeping the newest 500 lines). The settings page shows the latest 50 entr

ies.
- An n8n API key carries that instance's API authority. Register trustworthy instances only, ro

tate keys, and prefer a dedicated automation user.
- Publishing immediately affects production webho
ok and schedule triggers; deleting a workflow stops its triggers; deleting a tag removes it from eve
ry workflow; stopping an execution aborts business processing mid-flight; execution data can contain
business-sensitive payloads. The injected guidance requires the agent to confirm these operations w
payloads. The injected guidance requires the agent to confirm these operations with the user first.
## 🔐 Permissions & compatibility
- **Permissions**: writes one JSON file under the harness home (`~/.dsh` / `$DSH_HOME`); makes outbo
und HTTP(S) calls to the registered n8n instances; serves a loopback-only route family through the h

ost's web server. **No** command execution, no shell.
- **Compatibility**: DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (decl
ared as both `engines.dsh` and `dsh.engines.dsh`), Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, n8n public API v1 (1.

x and later; publishing has a modern/legacy fallback).
- **Lifecycle**: no `preinstall` / `install`

/ `postinstall` scripts — install and use.
- **Dependency posture**: the only runtime dependency is
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`; every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` package and `react` are optional peer depende
ncies — the plugin never re-installs, replaces or shadows official components.
## ⚠️ Known limitations
- The n8n public API still has no cross-version stable "run workflow manually" endpoint; `n8n_webhoo
k_call` fills that gap through the Webhook trigger — the workflow needs a Webhook node and must be p
ublished (or use `mode:"test"` while the editor listens for test events). Workflows without a Webhoo

k trigger must be run in the n8n UI, then inspected with `n8n_executions` / `n8n_execution_get`.
- P
ublic-API endpoints and fields differ across n8n versions (for example `publish/unpublish` alongside
`activate/deactivate`, and builds that return no `versionId`). The plugin falls back on a 404 for p
ublishing; `n8n_workflow_update` enforces optimistic concurrency whenever the instance exposes `vers
ionId` (a stale base version is refused, never overwritten), reports `concurrency: "unsupported"` ot

herwise; other differences are reachable through `n8n_api`.
- Tags CRUD, workflow-tag read/write and
execution stop rely on the instance exposing their public-API endpoints (`/tags`, `/workflows/{id}/
tags`, `/executions/{id}/stop`). Older n8n builds return 404 there; upgrade the instance or use `n8n

_api` for whatever it does expose.
- n8n caps tag names at 24 characters, and its API reports an ove
r-long name as a misleading `409 Tag already exists`; `n8n_tag_create` / `n8n_tag_update` reject it

before sending.
- A self-signed instance certificate is rejected by the DSH host's TLS validation; g

ive the instance a trusted certificate or use internal HTTP.
- Read-only mode and the audit trail ar
e enforced plugin-side: they gate the tools this plugin registers and do not narrow the n8n API key'
s own authority; calls made outside the plugin are unaffected. The audit log is a local plaintext JS

ONL file (no secrets, no response payloads); deleting the file clears the history.
- One mount per p
rofile: the built-in single-instance guard deduplicates a second row for the same package.
